title: Steering gate checks for workers
description: Worker-facing steering gate checks. unused_test runs the UNUSED stub test for one function (objectives/sms-real-codegen/unused-rule.md): the candidate is compiled with that function's body stubbed (signature kept) and every target function of the unit is compared.
status_message: Tool-local implementation: the API invokes toolpacks/gamecube-decomp/_impl/gamecube/tools/steering_check.py unused-test. Workers run it in their sandbox with cwd = the sandbox checkout.
limitations: Steering-gated games only (SMS); the wrapper refuses other games.
Requires a built checkout: build.ninja, target objects, MWCC compiler artifacts and an MWCC runner. The link map's UNUSED status is reported for context only.
The checkout is never written: C and the stubbed C' compile in shadow roots under /tmp, and parsed maps are cached outside the checkout.
A stub that does not build makes the result inconclusive, not dead.

usage.agent_guidance: Use on a function the original link map lists as UNUSED before keeping a body for it: dead means no target function changes, so the body must go (rule violation); inlined lists the same-unit callers it changes (the evidence that allows the body); inconclusive means the analysis is incomplete.
